title: Mistborn Curios
description: An add-on mod for Curios that adds multiple Misborn Inspired Baubles with powers loosly based off the books.
body:
This mod adds 9 Baubles for the Curios mod based on Brandon Sanderson's Mistborn. Each of these Baubles gives an effect based on the power system from the book. The Mistcloak gives a general boost, while the hemalergic spikes do the same but damage the player in the process. Each Ferachemical ring gives more specific powers depending on the metal. All can be found in chests, but spikes can also be dropped by certain mobs.



Curios API Mod Required
